intro.text: An obligator and High Prelan in the Canton of Finance.

items.text: When Camon, posing as Lord Jedue, came to the Canton of Finance to close his fake deal with Prelan Laird, Arriev met the group instead, saying he sat on the board reviewing it. His pointed questions alarmed Camon and Vin until Vin, fearing he would hand them to the Canton of Inquisition, used her hidden power on him; he turned pleasant and paid Camon three thousand boxings.

Kelsier and Dockson, watching, saw him leave with a Steel Inquisitor. The Ministry had suspected Camon all along: Arriev, skilled at sensing emotional Allomancy, had only faked his change of mood, expecting the Inquisitor to recover the money. The two went after the crew while two obligator spies tailed Camon and Vin, until Kelsier and Dockson drew off the Inquisitor and killed the spies.

appearance.text: Lean and muscular, unlike most obligators, with a shaved, triangular head and grey robes. Highly intricate tattoos around his eyes, reaching back to his ears and onto his forehead, mark his high rank.

personality.text: Confident and cunning; together with his looks, this makes him seem menacing.
